resources.string: Track store visits, one route at a time
Map tiles unavailable — check your connection. Your saved stores are not affected.
Alfamart Route Tracker needs your location to show where you are on the map and to confirm when you reach a store. Your location stays on this device.
Location is blocked for this app. Open the app settings and choose Permissions → Location → Allow.
You allowed approximate location only, so the blue dot can be off by a kilometre. Choose Precise in app settings for accurate store arrival.

Compares your stores with your completion history. It only reports what it finds — it never changes or deletes anything.
Counted but still shown as pending
Map marker count differs from the store count

Every store goes back to pending so you can visit them again. Your completion history is not deleted — past rounds stay in the History tab.

resources.string: Nothing left to visit in this round.
The service returned no stops. Try Recalculate.
Routing is not set up. Add an API key to use this.
Too many stops for one request. The service accepts up to 50.
Could not reach the routing service. Check your connection and try again.
The daily routing allowance is used up. Try again tomorrow.
Could not build a route. Nothing was changed. Try again.
Save your stores, completions and settings to a file you choose, or restore from one. No API keys or passwords are ever included.
Backup written. Keep the file somewhere safe.
Could not write the backup. Nothing was changed.
Could not read that file. Nothing was changed.
The restore failed and was rolled back. Your data is unchanged.
Restored: %1$d store(s) and %2$d completion(s). %3$d already existed and were kept.
It contains %1$s.\n\nMerge adds what is missing and keeps everything you have now. Replace deletes everything first.
Every store and completion currently in the app will be deleted and replaced by the backup. Anything you have added since the backup was made will be lost. This cannot be undone.
See how each round went — stores per day and how long it took.
No rounds yet. Complete a store and it will appear here.
Signing in identifies you. Sync is not built yet, so your stores and history stay on this phone either way.
Sign-in is not set up yet. Register this app\'s SHA-1 fingerprint in the Firebase console, enable Google as a sign-in provider, then download google-services.json again.
Signed out. Your stores and history are still on this phone.
You will be signed out. Your stores and completion history stay on this phone, and nothing is removed.
Sign in above to save your data to the cloud.
Cloud: could not be reached. Check your connection.
Cloud: something is saved there, but it is not a backup this app can read.
The cloud currently holds %1$s, saved %2$s.\n\nSaving replaces it with what is on this phone. Nothing on this phone is changed.
There is nothing to save yet. Add a store first.
Could not save to the cloud. Nothing was changed.
Sign in first — there is nowhere to save to otherwise.
The cloud holds %1$s, saved %2$s.\n\nMerging adds %3$s and keeps everything already on this phone.
The cloud holds %1$s, saved %2$s.\n\nEverything in it is already on this phone, so nothing would change.
Every store and completion currently on this phone will be deleted and replaced by the cloud copy. Anything you have added since the cloud was saved will be lost. This cannot be undone.
Retrieved: %1$d store(s) and %2$d completion(s) added, %3$d already here.
The cloud has nothing to retrieve yet. Save to the cloud first.
That cloud copy is not a backup this app can restore. Nothing was changed.
Could not read the cloud copy. Nothing was changed.
Sign-in was refused (%1$s). If you do have a Google account, send this text so it can be diagnosed.
Could not sign in (%1$s). Nothing was changed.
Sign-in is not set up yet.
Sign in to keep your stores and history on your Google account.
The app works fully without an account. Signing in only adds sync — your route stays on this phone either way.
